items.title: 4 Big Tech earnings reports, a Fed meeting, and $100 oil: It's the busiest week of the quarter
items.summary: Investors step into the busiest week of the quarter with hyperscaler earnings, the June Fed meeting, and escalations in the Middle East all in focus.

items.title: Google Joins Apple, Microsoft, Nintendo In Price Hikes As Memory Costs Surge Sixfold: Retail Bulls Unfazed After Q2 Capex Blow
items.summary: The entire Pixel family of devices will see price “adjustments” that “will be rolled out dynamically,” a top Google executive told 9to5Google.

items.title: S&P 500 On Track To Post Best Net Profit Margin Since 2009: Market Strategist Says Big Tech Is Driving An ‘Unprecedented Boom’
items.summary: As per The Kobeissi Letter, the S&P 500's net profit margin is on track to surge to 15.7% for Q2 2026, the highest since 2009.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive On Iran Hopes; Apple Leads Earnings Wave, Fed Meeting Ahead
items.summary: U.S.-Iran attacks have paused amid deal hopes. Apple, Amazon, Meta lead an earnings wave. A Fed rate hike is on the table.

items.title: Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta Will Spend Over $500 Billion on AI in 2026. Nvidia Collects a Huge Share.
items.summary: Three of the biggest AI budgets on Earth seem to just keep growing. The company selling the hardware fell anyway.

items.title: 5 Earnings Reports to Watch as Big Tech’s AI Spending Faces a Test
items.summary: Microsoft, Apple, Amazon and SK Hynix report this week as investors test Big Tech's AI spending against real returns.

items.title: The ‘Unsettled’ Vibe That’s Creeping Through the Markets
items.summary: This year’s stock rally has withstood war, inflation and uncertainty surrounding the tech sector’s massive artificial-intelligence investments.  The question now is: Have investors finally reached their limit?  Major stock indexes have posted healthy gains this year.
